name: Cheat Engine（KSword R0）
description: Runs Cheat Engine as a themed process action or a minimal native KSword Tab, with memory interaction routed through one persistent KSword driver session.

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Verify KSword R0, initialize the CE bridge and open the selected process.

commands.name: tab
commands.description: Attach the themed Cheat Engine main window to a minimal native child surface in the KSword Plugins Tab.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check whether the KSword R0 device is available without showing UI.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Print plugin capabilities as JSON Lines.
